connectionFields.name: Nickname
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Operator-chosen label in Entro; not a secret.

connectionFields.name: Domain Controller (DC)
connectionFields.obtainedHow: IP or hostname of a DC reachable from the Connector.

connectionFields.name: Username
connectionFields.obtainedHow: UPN of the read-only service account (e.g. svc_entro@domain).

connectionFields.name: Password
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Password for that service account; store in the operator vault.

connectionFields.name: Root CA (PEM)
connectionFields.obtainedHow: PEM of the AD CS root CA if LDAPS is required; paste the certificate, not a private key.

connectionFields.name: Environment Nickname
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Operator-chosen label in Entro; not a secret.

connectionFields.name: Environment Type
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Select Production, Development, or the matching environment type in the form.

prepSteps.title: Create a read-only AD service account
prepSteps.instruction: Create svc_entro (or equivalent) with Entro's documented read rights and confirm LDAPS from the Connector host to a DC.
prepSteps.evidence: The account exists in AD and the Connector host can reach the DC on LDAPS

uncataloged.evidence: The account exists in AD and the Connector host can reach the DC on LDAPS
